questions.question: What information should be recorded before troubleshooting an inverter?
questions.expected_evidence: Record the inverter model and displayed alarm code.

questions.question: Who may inspect an inverter enclosure?
questions.expected_evidence: Only qualified personnel may inspect an enclosure.

questions.question: What does the manual require before accessing an inverter enclosure?
questions.expected_evidence: Isolate all required sources and verify the safe state before access.

questions.question: Does the manual permit work on exposed energized conductors?
questions.expected_evidence: Never work on exposed energized conductors.

questions.question: What exact lockout/tagout sequence and voltage-test limits are required for inverter isolation?
questions.expected_evidence: The manual refers to site procedures but does not state a detailed sequence or voltage-test limits.

questions.question: When should photovoltaic modules be cleaned?
What cleaning tools and fluid does the manual describe?
questions.expected_evidence: Clean water and a soft, non-abrasive brush or cloth.

questions.question: Which cleaning methods are prohibited by the manual?
questions.expected_evidence: Do not use abrasive cleaners or high-pressure jets.

questions.question: What should a technician do if module cables or glass appear damaged?
questions.expected_evidence: Stop and report defects to the site supervisor.

questions.question: Which detergent brand and dilution ratio does the manufacturer approve?
questions.expected_evidence: No brand or dilution ratio is provided.

questions.question: What instrument is used during the thermal anomaly survey, and from where?
questions.expected_evidence: Use a suitable infrared camera from a safe, approved position.

questions.question: Which conditions should be recorded during the thermal survey?
questions.expected_evidence: Inspection time, weather, irradiance, and operating conditions.

questions.question: How should suspect modules be compared during the survey?
questions.expected_evidence: Compare nearby modules under similar conditions.

questions.question: What maximum temperature difference between neighboring modules is allowed?
questions.expected_evidence: The manual gives no numeric temperature-difference limit.

questions.question: Which PPE class, arc-flash boundary, and regulatory standard are required for the thermal survey?
questions.expected_evidence: The manual does not specify PPE classes, boundaries, or standards.
